description: Uncalibrated effective-stress Drucker-Prager plus irreversible implicit-gradient matrix damage. Project demonstration, not a reproduction or calibration of a named epoxy. Literature values below are references, not the active material parameters.

units.length_scale: same reference length unit as solver domain lengths; no implicit mm or micrometres

constitutive_hypotheses.stress: sigma = degradation(d) * sigma_effective in the matrix; fibers remain elastic
constitutive_hypotheses.damage_source: de Vree modified-von-Mises norm of total strain, with positive J2 = 0.5 * dev(strain):dev(strain)
constitutive_hypotheses.damage_evolution: zero below strain_threshold; otherwise 1 - strain_threshold/history * exp(-(history - strain_threshold)/softening_strain)
constitutive_hypotheses.history: max of confirmed history and current nonlocal field; no commit during a rejected or unconverged attempt

parameter_provenance.matrix: Existing project demonstration; no experimental epoxy fit
parameter_provenance.fiber: Existing project demonstration; no identified fiber grade
parameter_provenance.damage: Project demonstration; thresholds, ratio, length and residual stiffness are not literature-calibrated values
parameter_provenance.reference_domain_lengths: Reference domain used to interpret length_scale; pass consistent domain lengths to the solver

literature_reference_not_active_paramete.material: Resin L / GL 1, Roetsch, Stommel and Horst (2025)
literature_reference_not_active_paramete.limits: Two reported yield points do not reproduce the source paraboloidal surface or tabulated hardening. No damage-law calibration or adopted fracture energy. The unchanged 0.01 damage threshold would precede tensile yield if these reference parameters replaced the active demonstration.

model_sources.purpose: Exponential law, modified-von-Mises invariant convention and implicit-gradient Helmholtz
Heterogeneous FFT Helmholtz and staggered mechanical/nonlocal solution; different failure laws
